messages:
alex (support): Heads up: ACMEs ingest started failing after we moved their locked model alias. Errors show dimension mismatch.

acme-api: Correct. Started ~14:02 UTC. Our vector DB rejects batches: "expected 768 got 1024". Single and batch requests both returning 1024 now.

alex (support): Can you paste a minimal repro? Any client-side padding or custom batching?

acme-api: Curl attached: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d '{"model":"rw-embed-lock-acme","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'``` Response shows embeddings arrays length 1024. Request ids: r-20260317-01, r-20260317-02.

sara (eng-ml): Thanks. Need headers (x-model-id / x-internal-variant), request trace ids, and whether their alias was remapped to a different architecture (e.g., 768->1024).

alex (support): Theyre on our default client batching. Header sample: x-model-id: rw-embed-lock-acme, x-internal-variant: rw-embed-sim-xfer-v2. Logs show the model loaded as sim-xfer-1024.

jun (infra): Im checking deployment history. There was an automated swap for several locked aliases during a rollout window to reduce memory. A feature flag mis-evaluated and remapped some aliases to v2 variants that have a different embed_dim. Not intended.

mike (prod): Impacted customers need immediate rollback. Options: per-customer alias rollback, or force global revert. Also add a preflight check preventing alias swaps that change embedding schema.

alex (support): Proposed immediate action: rollback ACME alias to previous variant; collect the list of request ids during the window for customer replay; notify CS and AM. I told ACME ETA ~20m.

jun (infra): Initiating rollback now for cust:acme-prod. Also adding server-side guard: on alias remap check previous_variant.embed_dim == candidate_variant.embed_dim unless override present. Filing INC.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0491 - Locked alias remap changed embedding dimension. Priority: P1. Owner: jun (infra).

alex (support): ACME, can you re-run a small sample once I confirm rollback complete?

acme-api: Please escalate ASAP. This halts production ingestion. We need the request id list for 13:50-14:10 UTC window.

jun (infra): Rolled back alias at 14:15 UTC. Alias now points to rw-embed-sim-v1-stable. Im extracting request ids from request logs for the window and will DM the list.

alex (support): Rollback done. Waiting on ACME to replay. Also asked eng-ml to add a console warning when an alias remap would change dims.

acme-api: Replayed 5 batches; ingest now OK. Thanks. Please share postmortem and timeline; CC our account team.

sara (eng-ml): Well produce a short postmortem: root cause = feature-flagged alias remap that bypassed dim-compat check; immediate fixes = per-customer rollback + guard; medium-term = rollout RFC and console warnings + auto-notify customers on alias changes that affect schema. Ill own the PM.

alex (support): Closing loop with customer. Will attach incident link, PR numbers, and playbook steps when available. :thumbsup:
